I'll think through this as the farmer I am.

---

Well, I've been working this 10.9 mu for thirty years now. My family is big — eleven mouths — but the young ones are mostly away working in the city or in school, so it's mostly me and my wife on the land, with help from my son when he comes back. I split my land: about 8 mu goes to wheat-maize rotation because we need the grain for the family and to sell, and the other 2.9 mu I keep in cotton for cash. Cotton is more work but the price is better per mu when it's a good year.

**Wheat (8 mu):** I sowed this back in mid-October, as usual — I used a half-decent variety my cousin recommended, nothing fancy. Put down diammonium phosphate and some urea at planting, maybe 40 jin of compound fertilizer per mu. Now in spring I'll topdress urea at jointing — about 10 kg per mu. The extension fellow at the township said 15 kg of nitrogen per mu total is enough, but I usually do a bit more, maybe 17 or 18, because I'd rather spend an extra 20 yuan than see the wheat go yellow. I'll irrigate three times — green-up, jointing, and grain-filling — unless the sky helps me. Spray once for aphids if I see them. Expecting around 450 kg/mu if the weather behaves.

**Maize (8 mu, same land after wheat):** The week after wheat harvest in mid-June is the tight part. I don't till much — just no-till plant right into the stubble with a hired planter (the neighbor has one, he charges 20 yuan/mu). I use Zhengdan 958 or whatever hybrid the agri-shop pushes that year. Base fertilizer with compound at planting, then urea topdressing at the big-trumpet stage, 10-12 kg/mu. If it rains in July-August I don't irrigate at all; if it's dry I'll pump once. Expecting 500 kg/mu — last year I got 520 so that's my benchmark.

**Cotton (2.9 mu):** Plant in late April after the soil warms up. I buy Bt cotton seed — it saves me spraying for bollworm, which used to eat me alive. Put on a base of compound fertilizer, maybe 25 kg/mu, and topdress urea at budding and flowering — 12 kg N/mu total is about what I can afford. I have to spray 3-4 times for aphids, mites, and fungus. Water twice — budding and bolling. My wife and I pick by hand, three or four passes through September-October. That's where family labor really counts; we don't hire for picking unless my son can't come. Hoping for 250 kg lint per mu.

Total I'm putting in maybe 6,500 yuan across everything. I keep some cash back for emergencies — you never know with the weather.
